title: Addon for Keep Some Inventory - Aquaculture
description: Add support for Aquaculture to Keep Some Inventory.
body:
Drop your modded Aquaculture items on death!

"Keep Some Inventory" by PuckiSilver allows you to keep certain items on death. "Aquaculture" by Shadowclaimr or Shadow adds many items to your game.

[https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture)

This addon is for people who want any new non-equipment items to drop on death when you are using both of these mods together. This addon configures it so only armor, weapons, knives, fishing rods, and the fish trap will be kept on death. Bobbers, hooks, the worm farm block, and anything else _will_ drop on death. If you don't like my choices for any reason, you can modify my downloaded file as you see fit. You may also contact me if you think your suggestion will benefit other people or is potentially popular.

Keep Some Inventory uses an exclusion list to decide which items will be dropped on player death. This means any new items added to your game will not automatically be dropped on death. Rather, they will be kept. As such, addons can be used to extend this exclusion list without modifying the source (Keep Some Inventory). These addons are in data pack format.

This addon is compatible with both the data pack version and the modded version of Keep Some Inventory's release.
